text:
Sam: Quick RFC follow-up: proposal to make orchestration the single source of truth for per-request precision decisions. Thoughts?
Jess: Strong +1. Centralizing makes auditing and rollback easier. Need per-decision telemetry.
Kai: Agree but beware KV cache churn. Switching precision mid-session can invalidate caches and spike tail latency.
Maya: Contract idea: client may send `precision_hint`; orchestrator returns a compact `precision_decision` blob and `fallback_policy`. Runtime only takes small flags. Example: user_hint=prefer_fp8 -> orchestration=int8_requant, fallback=gradual->fp16.
Sam: Keep runtime simple: it should not autonomously change precision except for emergency failsafe.
Andrew: How do we support enterprise tenants that want to pin precision or opt-out?
Maya: Per-tenant overrides live in orchestrator policy engine at highest priority; decision evaluation order: tenant override -> route policy -> hints.
Jess: Telemetry per decision: decision_id, precision_requested, precision_applied, deg_score, latency_p50/p95, kv_cache_hit_rate. Also record policy_version.
Kai: Add `kv_cache_stability` to decision context. Orchestrator should avoid switches when stability is low.
Sam: Rollback playbook: if deg_score > threshold for duration, auto-roll back precision for affected routes and open Ops ticket; tenant rollbacks need human approval.
InfraBot: canary "precision-orch-canary" results: 8k reqs, avg latency +2.8ms, median deg_score 0.018, 9 errors.
Andrew: Investigating errors; check correlation with longctx or prompt shapes. If correlated, add prompt-shape guard rule.
Maya: Keep runtime payload minimal: `precision_decision`, `decision_id`, `kv_cache_action`, `stability_ttl_sec`. Defaults: 600s chat, 30s ephemeral.
Kai: Runtime changes small: accept {precision, requant, kv_cache_action, decision_id}; reuse KV state when decision_id matches.
Sam: Test matrix: (short vs long) x (fp8/int8/4bit) x (kv_cache_stability high/low), run shadowing + synthetic.
Andrew: Compliance: store decision audit (id, trigger, timestamp, policy_version) for Private customers.
Maya: I will draft the boundary API and runbook and post for review today.
Jess: Centralized orchestration = easier policy evolution and single telemetry surface. :+1:
Sam: Action items: update RFC to orchestration-first, add runtime flag contract, define telemetry schema, include per-tenant override story, and rollout checklist.
Kai: Add canary sentinel: pause rollout if kv_cache_hit_rate drops >20% after decision.
InfraBot: playbook PR: https://git.internal/redwood/precision-orch-playbook/pull/42
Maya: Pinged @Jess @Kai @Andrew for review.
Sam: Thanks everyone. End of thread.
